title: Making 10: Numbers 10 to 20
seo_title: Numbers 10 to 20 Class 1 Worksheet with Answers (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 4)
standard_text: Numbers 10 to 20: making 10, ten and some more, counting, reading and writing numbers to 20, comparing and ordering (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 Making 10 worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 4): ways to make 10, teen numbers, counting, comparing and ordering to 20. 100 picture questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Pairs that make 10: 1 + 9, 2 + 8, 3 + 7, 4 + 6, 5 + 5.
  • Teen numbers are 10 and some more: 16 = 10 + 6.

Examples

Example

How many more make 10 if you have 7?

7 + 3 = 10

Answer: 3

Example

What is 10 and 4 more?

10 + 4

Answer: 14

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing 13 as 31The 1 (one ten) comes first: 13.
Thinking 7 and 4 make 107 needs 3 more to make 10.
